disposition_reason: Lead, arsenic, cadmium and mercury measured in Wolffia globosa biomass cultivated in four nutrient media in outdoor tanks in Bangkok; Table 4 gives one mean per medium.

study.design: Cultivation experiment (four media, four replicate tanks, eight weeks) with product development
study.origin: Stock culture from King Mongkut's Institute of Technology Ladkrabang, Bangkok, Thailand; grown outdoors in 100 L tanks

findings.group: cultivated in AB hydroponic medium (commercial hydroponic fertilizer)
findings.locator: Table 4, row Lead (Pb), column AB, p. 8
findings.notes: Mean of four replicate tanks; SD printed as 0.00. Table caption says 'fresh' biomass while composition rows are % DW, so the basis of the metal values is not stated. Experimental outdoor tank cultivation, eight weeks. Values near or at two-decimal rounding of the reporting precision.
